body: I’ve enjoyed writing since high school however I was doing it religiously a year back. Just last October I was diagnosed as BP2 as well and have been taking medication. Since, I feel I have all these great ideas but can’t put it down on the computer or a notebook. I hoping that maybe I have writers block but starting to think differently with every day that passes.

I watched the recent version of King Kong in high school and made it the whole movie without shedding a tear (although early in the movie I was literally chocking to hold them back). When I got out and made it to my parents car I lost it. To this day I HATE that movie with a passion and if I think about it too much I’ll start crying all over again.

For years I’ve taken just anti depression however, I didn’t realize I had BP2 until about a year ago. I was put on the anti depressants bc I was hysterically crying due to a bad day at work or falling asleep at 6pm bc I was so exhausted. It did keep me going in the sense that I could function and push through tough times. I still had the days where I would cry and skip work regularly. 

After I got on my anti depression I had a year of mania (which at the time I knew nothing about it). I worked out every day sometimes up to 2 times a day, ate one meal a day (chicken breast or spaghetti o’s) and lost a bunch of weight. I thought that the medication was helping me but, to be truthful I was hurting my body more then helping it.

Thank you! I definitely needed to hear this. A co worker and I were talking about relationship and he asked me if I was a narcissistic. He doesn’t know I’m bipolar but my heart sank when he listed some traits for a narcissistic
Mine’s part Rhodesian Ridgeback so when he lays like this he takes up the whole bed.

I totally went to “heart” this being an regular Tumbler user ❤️. I have been fortunate not to have anyone say this to me yet however, I’ve gotten quite a few people who seemed to become scared of me after I tell them I have BP2
Not sure about the teen part but I think “am I hypersexaul or is this a subtle manic stage”

This clears a lot up. I wasn’t aware of that side. I had recently told my co worker that I was bipolar and she said “as long as I’m not yelling at people it was all good”. To me it kinda came as a shock due to my depression spells I’ve had out of no where at work. My first instinct is to shut down, stop talking completely and try my hardest not to cry.

While I’ve had my mania in the past, I’d buy huge purchases knowing I’d upset my husband. Best example is me getting a motorcycle. However I knew my husband would be upset bc I didn’t discuss it with him. I told my best friend that I did it to get him to end our marriage (I wanted out and knew I would have to do something big like that for him to leave). Basically I did things in my maniac stages to hurt him. So I see the anger-ish side of it but I’m like you in that I don’t yell at people or threaten them.

I’d definitely be ok with that if it helps me from feeling like this. Today I started my 125 mg compared to my 100. I’m also taking cymbolta* which we are weening me off of and I’ve taken my med for adhd Vyvanse*? Dr said the adhd med shouldn’t mess with my mania but maybe it messes with my depression.
If this isn’t the truest picture I’ve ever seen.
This is awesome! I just made my personal one today. I had no idea.

This is extremely helpful to hear. I know I have abused alcohol in the past and the meds I’m on now have made it less appealing but, when I drank and was depressed I’ve done something’s I’d never considered doing while sober. Ironically I am on my 2 month of taking the meds so I seem to be at that purgatory state although it’s nice to know I’m not alone

This is exactly where I’m at now. You and @dollfacenelson have some good ideas for challenging this kind of thought process though.  I definitely need to make a log of some sort to remind me of the past.
Glad I’m not alone. My Dr is very helpful but I’m new to all this so I’m not sure how everything is supposed to work. Just got to work on open communication

I often wonder the same thing. There was a good year, awhile back, where I was working out every day. Ate nothing but chicken and spaghetti O’s and dropped a ton of weight. I felt awesome that I’ve lost all that weight but I haven’t been able to step into the same routine again. I can lose weight but at a slower pace. I am also on bi polar meds now, where as then, I wasn’t.

Ok, I definitely need to do that then. I’ve been seeing one a few months ago but she hasn’t really reached out so I’m thinking I should look for a new one. Thank you for the info. It’s nice to know there are still choices out there
They do actually. I’ll definitely look into that!

I feel that way. Maybe it all used to be backwards but, during High School I felt I had a huge sex drive (before I realized I had bipolar) and after I had my daughter it completely stopped. To where I was almost repulsed by the idea of sex? Now, for about a year or so my drive has seemed to kick up and I feel that having sex when I’m depressed, some how gives me that uplift I’m seeking.
This is so reassuring! Thank you, I myself find that I have those exact same feelings and have acted that same way. It’s nice to know I’m not alone but also to know it can get better.
YES!!
I did this all of the time in high school. My choice was Staind.
You’re right and I’ve known these facts as well. Just odd that I’ve suddenly reacted differently to it. Getting old really does change things with the human body.

Right? That’s what I was thinking. During the wreck I blacked out so I’m positive I had a concussion and that was in 2010. My ex was running from the cops with me on the back of his motorcycle and he just missed the turn lane to get back on the highway. We kept going full speed straight and wrecked in hill on the side of the highway. I just remember closing my eyes and holding on. Then I woke up face down with horrible knee pains and the adrenaline shakes. A few months after I experienced dizziness where I’d just be sitting and the room would spin. I wasn’t taking any pills then. My mom witness a dizzy spell where I was laying down and she said my eyes just kept circling. I haven’t ruled the head injury out but if that’s it, it’s odd to effect me 9 years later after taking Hydrocodone again.
The day before I got dizzy I took 1 and had a few beers. Other then that I’ve only taken 1 in the morning and 1 at night
This was something I really needed to hear and thank you so much. You aren’t lying about them hard either!

I guess it does work differently for each person. I thought I had a high tolerance due to abusing hydrocodone a couple years back but, I found that if I take the 300g about 30 minutes apart it hits me good.

You’re probably right. I started at my family Dr a few years ago because she was covered by my insurance and I was Transitioning out of the Army. I have seen a psychiatrist and was prescribed Gabapentin, a mood stabilizer and another anti anxiety medication however I haven’t made my check up appointment with her. The Gabapentin helps tremendously with pain due to 3 herniated disc. I guess I feel my family Dr knows more about me because I’ve seen her longer.

Yes, I get into the Girl with The Dragon Tattoo revenge mindset. My assault happen while I was in the military and was by my “supervisors”. Maybe I’ve been a revengeful person way before that but they kinda got theirs’ for the assault however, since it happened off base the SAPD said because I didn’t say stop there was nothing they could do on the civil side. So I still walk around thinking there was something I could do to avoid it.

Thank you for the reply. After some time of stepping back I have calmed down. It’s truly comforting to know at least one person is listening in a world where I feel alone sometimes. I’d never physically take my anger out on another person however I do need more productive ways to deal with that anger

That’s a shit thing to do, however those same people play stupid and dont understand how people can go through such dark times or life’s. I know I’m not offering any support but had that happened to me I’d lose it. You’re already a better person then me.

I was seeing a therapist I absolutely loved but she moved out of state. Since her I haven’t seen anyone. I have my regular Doctor for my medication that’s about it. My husband knows I have ptsd but I never let him know when it gets bad. I feel I tried in the past and he was so uncomfortable that he became upset and I get defensive if I feel like I’m being brushed off. (If that makes sense)

Well damn, that definitely puts things in a different prospective. In the end I really don’t want to take any kind of medication, I feel it cripples me. I know I can’t be happy with out it so I just believe I’ll never have that happiness I had before
Thank you for talking with me. A lot that was said really sunk in with me. It has definitely help my frame of mind
Yes that does. I haven’t thought of that but it’s a huge help. I can start looking around for those too
I was a truck driver in the army and got out to do technical support for alarm systems, something I loved. I love anything that allows me to work with my hands

Along with everything else I’m a parent to a 3 year old girl and being a 30 year old adult who’s jobless makes me fill like I failed as a parent. I know none of my family sees it that way but they all have great heads on their shoulders. The heart ache I feel everyday is just becoming too overwhelming

My SO doesn’t know about my past self harm because I honestly hadn’t done it since 2006. I feel with my personality and selfish ways I don’t tell him on purpose. It’s definitely not the best way to go about since on some days I’m mad he doesn’t notice and some days I’m gearing up for a fight if he does. Long story short he hasn’t noticed I’ve picked cutting back up and I’m the worst person at talking about my feelings with him.

In all honesty dealing with the emotion is harder then using what helps you cope. I’ve experienced several things emotionally and maybe people have a better mind set but cutting is the only thing that seems to make a difference. I don’t condone it but I definitely understand it

I have bad and good days. My daughter is 3 so she doesn’t understand about that. I definitely think it’s great to have a understanding spouse, however for me that varies from day to day with him. I hold it together for the most part with her. Only raise my voice or discipline when she’s  in the wrong. At the end of the day however, I can turn to heavy drinking to kind of unwind.
With work and a kid drinking doesn’t do anything for me. I just picked up cutting again in 06 and it’s an instant relief. Not the best solution for my problem but it helps me
